catalog.note: JDM full-line catalogue (men's, ladies' and pocket/stopwatch sections). Grid pages print each caption as ● model code + jewels (石) + number, e.g. '●52KWM 25石 010' -> ref 52KWM-010 (ladies' '17QS 20石 R-105' -> 17QS-R-105; the printed line is kept in `code`), then the description lines (translated into `notes`), the material·WR line (SS, SGP, TSGP, GC gold cap, WGP/WGF/AWGP/AWGF white-gold plated/filled, ASGP/APDP/ACRP A-grade gold/palladium/chrome plate, PDP, PMP, CRP, SILV/SILP silver, NSB, ALM light alloy, AAPC, 14K/18K, RP rainproof) with the list price in yen, and a <NNN-NNN> case–dial code (kept as caseDialCode). No bracelet/strap part codes are printed; the band type is noted from the photo. caliber is set only where the model code is itself the movement number (2220, 2201, 2409, 2415, 2418, 2431, 2435, 6117, 6618, 6800, 1944); family codes (38SQW, 56KAW, 11S, 1700 …) leave it blank. Quartz and electronic models print no jewel count. The men's and ladies' special-selection openers (scan 3-8 and 87-92) are photo spreads with a price list at the foot of the page; on scan 91 that list is printed too faintly to read. Printed page numbers are scan index - 2. Several ladies' refs carry hand-drawn pen circles in this copy.
catalog.method: vision transcription of 250 DPI renders, Oct 2026, verified against caption crops: every pictured watch (photo boxes from a caption-anchored panel detector plus hand-set boxes on the photo spreads and fancy-watch pages) given its own record and photo, each caption checked on 300-700 DPI caption tiles with the PDF text layer used only as a cross-check.
